extracted.name: Knödel
extracted.description: Knödel is an Austrian dumpling casserole that bears a resemblance to a savory bread pudding or stuffing. Seasoned bread is baked with egg and more.
ingredient_lines: 0.5 (1 pound) loaf white bread, toasted and cut into cubes
instruction_lines: Combine onion, parsley, and butter in a skillet over medium heat. Cook until onions begin to brown. Pour over bread cubes and toss well.
Whisk together milk, eggs, salt, and pepper. Pour over bread and onion mixture; mix well and allow to stand for 1 hour.
Firmly press mixture into the prepared baking dish; tightly cover with aluminum foil.
Place the baking dish on a rack in a larger pot with 3 inches of water. Cover pot and steam for 1 hour.
Remove the dish from the pot of water and allow to cool for 10 minutes.
